description: List the product categories this server can actually source, with the structured spec fields each one carries (a vehicle has year, make, model, mileage; a tool has drive size and torque). Call it before a first search to learn which `vertical` values are accepted, or when a search returns nothing and you need to check the category is covered at all. Free, instant, no side effects. Protocol v1.0 §8.2.
name: demand.list_verticals

verticals.description: Every vertical this server can match demand in.

key.description: Identifier to pass as the `vertical` argument, e.g. "vehicles".

spec_keys.description: Structured spec fields carried for items in this vertical.

title: List supported verticals
